final: {"prompt":"Create a square, edge-to-edge abstract painting with no frame or surrounding setting. Make it purely nonrepresentational: use no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Build the composition from a dense, restless center of layered cobalt, bruised violet, and hot vermilion, where rough, dry-brushed strokes collide with translucent washes and fine granular texture. Let sharp, high-contrast marks pulse outward in uneven rhythms, then dissolve into broad fields of smoky teal and muted ochre. Keep one large pocket of near-black negative space off center, edged by thin luminous threads of pale blue and chalk white. Balance compressed clusters of texture against open, quiet expanses; let the brushwork feel searching, interrupted, and alive, with visible overlaps, scraped passages, and abrupt shifts in density. Full-bleed painting, square format."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
